notes: Owner specification-review ruling of 2026-08-31, which approved this missing composition proposition for registration and implementation and specified its content. Registered as ruled: in the production `ClientProxy` path the `SignedRequest` handed to `RemoteTransport::round_trip` is the same owner the `ResponseExpectation` is derived from, and the notification analogue is included because the root consumes it — the acknowledgement verifier receives `signed.request()` from that owner directly. Owned by `client.proxy_request_correspondence`, the smallest client-proxy composition authority; `client.response_acceptance` was NOT widened merely because it consumes the result. Evidence is a compile-time source scan through `include_str!`, whose negative member — the shipped path reconstructs no second request — is what makes the correspondence load-bearing.
subject: THM-0084
